name: Anjuna Beach
brief_description: North Goa beach known for cliffs, the Wednesday flea market, and a slower scene than Baga/Calangute.
rationale: Matches a 'chill, no parties' vibe better than the central beaches and is well-supplied with mid-budget shacks.

name: Old Goa churches walk
brief_description: UNESCO-listed Portuguese colonial churches in Velha Goa — Basilica of Bom Jesus, Sé Cathedral, Church of St. Francis.
rationale: Half-day, low-cost cultural anchor that breaks up beach days; closes Sundays for services so plan accordingly.

name: Divar Island day trip
brief_description: Quiet island in the Mandovi reachable by ferry from Old Goa; bicycle the inland villages and stop at the church on the hill.
rationale: Off the typical tourist track, cheap, and explicitly low-key — fits the 'chill' brief.
